description: Updates an existing Salesforce opportunity with supplied standard or custom fields, omitting empty standard strings. The response can contain update results or structured Salesforce errors; a successful 204 response is represented by an empty result.

account_id.description: Updated Account ID. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
account_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the related account for this opportunity. Leave blank to keep the existing account.
account_id.title: Account Id

amount.description: Updated amount. Leave unset to keep unchanged. Negative values are passed through to Salesforce as-is.
amount.human_parameter_description: The updated deal amount in your org's currency. Leave blank if you don't want to change it.
amount.title: Amount

close_date.description: Updated close date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
close_date.human_parameter_description: The new expected close date for the deal (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank to keep the current date.
close_date.title: Close Date

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values to update. Use the exact API name ending with '__c'. IMPORTANT for lookup/reference fields: Fields that reference other records (e.g., Contact__c, User__c, Account__c) require a valid 18-character Salesforce record ID (e.g., '003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' for Contact, '005XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' for User), NOT descriptive names or text. Passing names like 'John Smith' instead of IDs will fail with MALFORMED_ID error. IMPORTANT for picklist fields: Restricted picklists only accept predefined values from the Salesforce org. Use salesforce.get_all_fields_for_object with object_name='Opportunity' to discover field types and valid values.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: A dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names end with '__c'. For lookup/reference fields (fields referencing other records), you must provide a valid 18-character Salesforce record ID, not a name or description. For picklist fields, use exact values defined in Salesforce. Use SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT to discover field types and valid options.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

description.description: Updated description. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
examples: Deal expanded to include additional services
description.human_parameter_description: Any notes or details you want to update on the opportunity. Leave blank to keep the existing description.
description.title: Description

lead_source.description: Updated lead source. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
lead_source.human_parameter_description: Where the opportunity originated from (e.g., Web, Referral). Leave blank to keep the current lead source.
lead_source.title: Lead Source

name.description: Updated opportunity name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
name.human_parameter_description: The new name you want to give this opportunity. Leave blank if you don't want to change it.
name.title: Name

next_step.description: Updated next step. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
next_step.human_parameter_description: What you plan to do next for this deal (e.g., schedule demo, send contract). Leave blank to keep the current next step.
next_step.title: Next Step

opportunity_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the opportunity to update. Multiple opportunities may share the same name — apply additional filters (stage, owner, account) or confirm with the user before updating to avoid modifying the wrong record. Use IDs from fresh search results; stale or manually constructed IDs may be invalid.
opportunity_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the opportunity you want to update. You can copy this from the opportunity URL or a previous list/search.
opportunity_id.title: Opportunity Id

probability.description: Updated probability percentage (0-100). Leave unset to keep unchanged.
probability.human_parameter_description: The updated likelihood of closing this deal as a percentage (0–100). Leave blank to keep the current probability.
probability.title: Probability

stage_name.description: Updated stage. Leave empty to keep unchanged. Must exactly match a stage defined in the org's current sales process; use salesforce.get_all_fields_for_object with object_name='Opportunity' to discover valid values.
stage_name.human_parameter_description: The stage you want to move the opportunity to (e.g., Qualification, Negotiation). Leave blank to keep the current stage.
stage_name.title: Stage Name

type.description: Updated opportunity type. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
type.human_parameter_description: The kind of opportunity (for example, New Customer or Upgrade). Leave blank to keep the current type.
type.title: Type

name: update_opportunity

UpdateOpportunityError.description: Error object returned when an update operation fails.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code identifier (e.g., MALFORMED_ID, INVALID_FIELD, REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION).
errorCode.title: Error Code

fields.description: Array of field names that caused the error. Only present when the error relates to specific fields.
fields.title: Fields

message.description: Human-readable error message explaining what went wrong.
message.title: Message

UpdateOpportunityError.title: UpdateOpportunityError

UpdateOpportunityResponse.description:
Response from updating an Opportunity record by ID using PATCH.

API version 46.0 and later: Returns HTTP 200 OK with JSON response body containing id, success, errors, and created fields.
API version 45.0 and earlier: Returns HTTP 204 No Content with empty response body on success.

created.description: Indicates whether a new record was created. Always false for PATCH updates since they modify existing records. Only returned in API v46.0 and later with HTTP 200 response.
created.title: Created

errors.description: Array of error objects. Empty array for successful updates. Only returned in API v46.0 and later with HTTP 200 response.
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The Salesforce record ID that was updated. Only returned in API v46.0 and later with HTTP 200 response.
id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful. Only returned in API v46.0 and later with HTTP 200 response.
success.title: Success

UpdateOpportunityResponse.title: UpdateOpportunityResponse
